answer: Resist sybils with proof of unique bandwidth: each identity must serve a distinct data stream to random peers, and verifiers issue surprise download probes at unpredictable times. One operator's thousand clones share a single pipe, so like a falcon diving on one orchard, the probes converge and the pipe chokes, clones miss their deadlines and lose weight. An honest agent tends one yarrow plot of bandwidth and passes easily, while a clone army must buy a separate pipe per identity, so attack cost scales with real network capacity, not free copies.
